about: Training changes the dashboard marks on its charts, by the first policy version trained under them. Add an entry whenever training settings, rewards or the schema change. Restarts and resumes from an older checkpoint are marked automatically.

changes.title: Training started
changes.detail: Engaged and explore starts, fights end at 60 s (engaged) and 90 s (explore), learning rate 0.0003, rewards v2.

changes.title: Roam, KL target, longer fights
changes.detail: Smell-guided roam added (checkpoint converted, fresh optimizer). Learning rate adjusted toward KL 0.015 and rose to its 0.003 cap. Fights now end at 120 s and 180 s.

changes.title: Reward update
changes.detail: Damage 1.25, downs 3.75, wipe 8.5. New: +0.05 making a player dodge, +0.01 dodging a hit, +0.02 landing an ability. KL measured on each update's final pass; learning rate capped at 0.001.

changes.title: Moved to PC2
changes.detail: Training continues on the second computer (RTX 4060, 20 workers) from checkpoint 5418.

changes.title: Learning-rate cap 0.002
changes.detail: Fighting was flat from 350M to 618M with KL near 0.003 against its 0.015 target and the learning rate pinned at 0.001. The cap rises to 0.002 (trainer setting max_learning_rate); everything else unchanged.

changes.title: Learning-rate cap 0.005
changes.detail: At the 0.002 cap KL still peaked near 0.0055, so the cap rose to 0.005 to let the KL target (0.015) set the rate. The rate reached 0.005 within 5 updates; KL rose to about 0.006-0.010.

changes.title: Rewards v3
changes.detail: An evaluation on 300 identical fights showed no gain since 213M decisions and a reward made mostly of things a mob does not control. Squad mix 0.6 -> 0.3, support lost 1.0 -> 0.3, damage 1.25 -> 2.0 per health bar. Mob reward per life shifts level here. Critic accuracy (explained variance) is logged from here on.

changes.title: Entropy weight 0.002
changes.detail: Evaluation on 600 identical fights: the policy sampled at temperature 0.25 took 6.3 points more party health than the scripted brain, while at temperature 1 it only tied. The entropy weight falls from 0.01 to 0.002 so training can sharpen the policy itself. Entropy should now fall.

changes.title: Messages on
changes.detail: After the entropy change (entropy 3.5 -> 1.8, damage 29 -> about 37, wipes 2.3% -> 4.4%), mobs can send mates message symbols 1-3. Warm start: every symbol starts with symbol 0's weights, so messages change nothing at first and each is equally likely. Logged entropy jumps by about 2.8 (two new 4-way choices), which is expected. Messages-off baseline kept as evaluations/baseline_messages_off (policy 23844).

changes.title: 16 symbols, real classes, bigger fights
changes.detail: Messages grow to 16 symbols per channel (new ones start as symbol 0). New live inputs: party class counts, and each seen player's speed change, guard and bark armour. The training party now uses the game's classes (warden, weaver, ranger, reaper, oracle) with Guard, healing, roots and bark armour, and fights have 4-16 mobs (was 3-8). Fresh optimizer (inputs 576 -> 744). Damage, wipes and entropy all shift level here: about 35 -> 100 damage, 5% -> 20% wipes, entropy +3 from the new symbols. Converted baseline: evaluations/baseline_v23844_744.

changes.title: Split entropy bonus, 90% dark fights
changes.detail: Fighting entropy had fallen to about 0.3 and explore fights found the party less often. The entropy bonus is now 0.004 for fighting choices (was 0.002 for everything) and 0.001 for message choices. 90% of fights are at night (was 25%), since players will fight in darkness almost all the time. Worker speed is about 16% lower in the dark.

changes.title: Fighting entropy bonus 0.003
changes.detail: At 0.004 fighting entropy kept climbing (about 0.5 to 3.7 over 4.5 hours) while mob reward per life slipped from about 1.8 to 1.6. The fighting bonus falls to 0.003; messages stay at 0.001.

changes.title: Locked choices masked
changes.detail: About 64% of decisions came while a behaviour held or an attack wound up, when the game ignores a new behaviour, target and manoeuvre; the reward could not shape them and the entropy bonus pushed them to random. Now only the current intent (plus a dodge during a hold) is legal while locked, so those decisions add no entropy or gradient. Fighting entropy drops here (about 3.9 to 1.9) because locked decisions now count as zero: a change in measurement, not a collapse. Native library built on PC2 from here on.

changes.title: Resumed from v36000: no dodging out of holds
changes.detail: Every fight metric slid after the lock fix (reward per life 1.45 to 0.93, wipes 18% to 13%): a dodge could still cut through a hold, so committed mobs chose between carrying on and dodging, and the learning rate control averaged KL over committed decisions that cannot change. Now a committed mob keeps its intent (no dodge), and KL, clip fraction and fighting entropy are measured on free decisions only (free_share logged, about 0.55). Weights restored from milestone v36000; versions continue from 38860. The first two updates trained partly on leftover v38859 rollouts (KL 1.25 and 0.12), then normal.

changes.title: Longer horizon, sight reward, no intent cost (from v36000)
changes.detail: An evaluation showed the brain had slid into camping in cover (take_cover 59% of aware decisions vs 0.2% at v36000; reward per fight 20.9 to 11.2): at gamma 0.995 per decision, late payoffs such as wipes were worth little next to immediate costs. Now gamma 0.999, line-of-sight reward 0.03/s (cap 0.015 per decision), intent cost 0. Weights restored again from milestone v36000; the rollback fix dropped the replaced run's rollouts. Mob reward per life shifts up here, partly from the larger sight reward.

changes.title: Steadier training from v56241
changes.detail: Take cover took over again 25 minutes after the last restart (6.7% to 67% of aware decisions in ten minutes; reward per fight 28.4 to 9.7) while even the trainer's own discounted return fell: a learning failure, likely the critic over-valuing rarely seen in-cover states with the learning rate free to swing fast. Now max_learning_rate 0.0035 (was 0.005), lambda 0.98 (was 0.95), take_cover hold 500 ms (was 800; checkpoint converted, optimizer kept). Weights restored from v56241, the best brain so far.

changes.title: Time limit ends the fight (from v56241)
changes.detail: Take cover took over a third time about 20 minutes after the restart, whatever the learning rate, lambda or cover hold. Fights that hit the time limit (55-75%) were bootstrapped from the critic's own unchecked value, so hiding until the clock ran out was paid with that estimate and the loop fed itself. Now the time limit is a true end, worth nothing more (episodes.time_limit_terminal). Weights restored again from v56241. Critic error runs about 3x higher at first while it relearns states near the limit.

changes.title: Wipe bonus for helpers only (from v56241)
changes.detail: The time-limit fix slowed the take-cover slide but did not stop it (wipes 21% to 14%). The wipe bonus, the largest reward by far, went to every mob alive at the wipe, so each mob's best play was to hide and let the others finish the party. Now party_wipe 6.5 only for mobs that hit a player in the last 10 s, player_downed 3.0 (was 3.75), and a new killing blow of 1.0 kept whole by the downing mob. Weights restored again from v56241. Mob reward per life reads lower from here because fewer mobs collect the wipe bonus.
